subject: Security exhibit: evidence map & pen-test window (MSA + Order Form)
body:
From: Sarah Young <sarah.young@helixtx.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Williams <tom.williams@helixtx.com>, Helix Therapeutics Legal <legal@helixtx.com>
Date: Sat, 05 Dec 2026 14:08:00 -0800
Subject: Security exhibit questions + pen-test timing

Hi Aisha,

Thanks for sending the redlined MSA and the draft security exhibit earlier this week. Our legal team had a few follow-ups as we align internal procurement and the engineering schedule. Two quick asks so we can finalize the Order Form: 

1) Pen-test window: we need to lock a 48-hour window for an external penetration test in Q1. Can you confirm Redwood's preferred blackout windows (maintenance, model upgrades) and who on your end will be the point of contact for staging access?

2) SOC 2 evidence: Helix requires either the latest SOC 2 report plus an evidence runbook or a short attest letter if you can't share the full report. What's realistic for Redwood to provide by Jan 15?

If useful, we can share our draft schedule and a short list of the artifacts we anticipate asking for (log retention policy, user access matrix, network diagrams).

Appreciate the help — procurement is trying to finalize budget approvals next week.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Young
Director, IT Security
Helix Therapeutics

---

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Young <sarah.young@helixtx.com>
Cc: Tom Williams <tom.williams@helixtx.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Security exhibit questions + pen-test timing

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear asks. Short answers up front, then proposed next steps: 

- Pen-test window: we can commit to a 48-hour external pen test. Preferred blackout windows are the first business day of each month (deploy freeze) and ad-hoc major model upgrades — we will flag those 30 days in advance. For Q1 we have open windows the weeks of Jan 11 and Feb 8; please let us know which week you prefer and we'll reserve a slot. Point of contact for staging access will be me for scheduling and Priyom for technical on-boarding.

- SOC 2 evidence: we can provide the SOC 2 Type II report for the 2025 assessment and a tailored evidence runbook. The report itself is restricted to customers under NDA; if Helix is OK with an NDA + DPA addendum we can provide the full report by Jan 12. If you need only an attestation letter, we can produce that by Dec 20.

Proposed next steps:
1) Laura, our legal lead, will share a short redline to the security exhibit clarifying staging access scope and the requirement that pen tests be coordinated with Redwood ops (start/end times, allowed IP ranges).
2) I'll add Priyom to the thread to confirm the technical checklist for staging.
3) Sarah — can Helix confirm whether signing an NDA + DPA is acceptable to access the SOC 2 report? If yes, we will queue the DocuSign link and an evidence list.

Attachments: I attached the current security exhibit (v3) and a draft pen-test scope spreadsheet for comment.

Thanks — Aisha

--
Aisha Rahman
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
aisha@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0124

Attachment: Redwood_Security_Exhibit_v3.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)
Attachment: pen-test-scope-draft.xlsx (Excel, 24KB)

---

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Young <sarah.young@helixtx.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Tom Williams <tom.williams@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Security exhibit questions + pen-test timing

Hi Sarah — looping in a short legal update / redline summary to prevent back-and-forth. Please see bullets below; I can provide tracked changes if that helps.

- Staging access: Redwood agrees to provide time-limited staging access for pen testing. We request that Helix provide a list of test IPs and a signed non-disclosure addendum that limits use of any forensic artifacts. Proposed clause: "Redwood will grant time-limited, least-privilege access to a staging environment for agreed-upon testing; customer must coordinate tests at least 14 days in advance and provide an IP allowlist."

- Audit rights / SOC 2: We can provide SOC 2 Type II report under a mutual NDA and a DPA addendum; unlimited inspection rights and live audits are not feasible. Proposed exhibit text to limit audit rights to: (i) receipt of SOC 2 report (or attestation letter), (ii) bounded inspection point-in-time with Redwood-approved scope and staffing, and (iii) access to specific evidence artifacts listed in the runbook.

- Pen-test findings: Redwood requests that vulnerabilities discovered during the engagement be routed to Redwood security first for triage with a 72-hour remediation SLA for critical findings where feasible. Any public disclosure must be coordinated and mutually agreed.

If Helix legal wants track-changes, I can push an annotated PDF by EOD.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference

---

From: Sarah Young <sarah.young@helixtx.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Williams <tom.williams@helixtx.com>, Helix Therapeutics Legal <legal@helixtx.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 12:44:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Security exhibit questions + pen-test timing

Laura — thanks, that language is reasonable. A couple points from Helix: 

- We can sign an NDA + DPA addendum; please send the DocuSign link and we'll route internally.
- For the pen test we will provide an IP allowlist and can commit to giving Redwood 72 hours to triage before any external disclosure. We prefer the Jan 11 week for the test window if you can reserve it.

Tom (cc) will coordinate the technical details; he may reach out to Priyom directly this afternoon to walk the staging environment checklist.

Best,
Sarah

---

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Tom Williams <tom.williams@helixtx.com>, Sarah Young <sarah.young@helixtx.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 16:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Security exhibit questions + pen-test timing

Hi Tom / Sarah — quick technical checklist so we don't miss anything before Jan 11: 

1) Staging environment snapshot (version, commit hash) — Redwood provides; Helix to confirm testing against snapshot or live replica.
2) Account provisioning: create scoped test account(s) with RBAC; provide Helix test usernames at least 7 days before window.
3) IP allowlist: Helix to submit CIDR ranges 10 days prior.
4) Log access: Redwood will provide read-only access to security logs for the test window and a delivery mechanism for raw artifacts (S3 link).
5) Escalation: security findings triage channel (Slack invite) + primary ops contact (pri_dom@redwood.com) and backup.

If Jan 11 is confirmed, please share the IPs and a signed NDA by Dec 20 so we can provision accounts and run a smoke test the week of Jan 4.

Thanks — Priyom

Attachment: SOC2_Report_2025.pdf (access-controlled PDF)
Attachment: OrderForm_Helix_Unsigned.pdf (PDF stub)

---

Notes / next actions (summary):
- Helix to confirm NDA + DPA (Helix confirmed willingness; awaiting DocuSign).
- Redwood will reserve Jan 11 pen-test week and run a smoke test week of Jan 4.
- Laura to provide tracked redline to security exhibit and pen-test clause by EOD 12/07.
- Helix to provide IP allowlist and test team contact by 12/20.

Attachments referenced above are stubbed; final exhibits and the DocuSign order form link will be sent once NDA is executed.
This thread contains internal Redwood participants only from the allowed mailbox set and external Helix contacts.
